in_marathi.name: Kaibalya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kaibalya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kaibalya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kaibala', which means 'Goddess of Knowledge'. This name is believed to symbolize wisdom, knowledge, and intelligence.
